title: Bounded comparison with the Prédhumeau–Manley Canadian synthetic population

resource.checksum_limitation: The publisher exposes MD5 for this archive; extracted evidence must add SHA-256.

download_policy.reason: The pinned archive is approximately 9.6 GB.

comparison_scope.da_identity_policy: No DA-level join: the external projection uses 2016 DA identities and the local output uses 2021 DA identities.
comparison_scope.execution_requirement: Regeneration is opt-in and requires the pinned extracted member plus local SynthPopCan Nunavut CSV outputs; default tests validate the committed aggregate without downloading either source.
comparison_scope.truth_status: Both populations are modelled artifacts; neither is observed record-level truth.

schema_crosswalk.rule: No field is compared until its categories, universe, unit, and denominator are explicitly aligned.

fixture.purpose: Offline deterministic validation of schema and checksum plumbing.

required_empirical_evidence: bounded extracted-slice SHA-256 and row count
limitations: The external 2021 population is a projection from a 2016 base, so dataset year and source Census vintage must not be conflated.
The committed CSV is fictional; the separate JSON contains only territory aggregates from an opt-in empirical method-to-method run.
The empirical member is the FA scenario, not the LG scenario used for validation in the associated article.
The 2016-versus-2021 DA identity mismatch prevents a DA-level join without a reviewed crosswalk.
The complete archive is not suitable for default CI or an ordinary package installation.
This descriptor does not authorize a national-quality claim.
